description:
One public search over the receipt sources, newest first. Not `/v1/search`
(that is the domain search).

Use this tool when:
- you want to find a TunnelMind change by ref, kind or summary.
- you want one newest-first view of TunnelMind's changes and the attested tollbooth commons.
- you want a past day's signed station-health rows (`source=weather-health`).

Three public sources, and only these:
- `changes` — the receipts ledger, lens `config` with `change:*` and
  `toolset:*` subjects (the same set as `GET /v1/changes`; a `kind` narrows
  it to one), mapped like `GET /v1/changes`
  so a row reads as a change, not a hash.
- `commons` — tollbooth receipts from attested sites only.
- `weather-health` — the signed station-health rows (lens `wx-health`),
  read from the public weather relay one CLOSED UTC day at a time. Every
  row is verified under the pinned weather key; a day that fails
  verification degrades the whole source. No row from the open (current)
  UTC day enters: the live 5-minute answer is `station_health`
  (`GET /v1/weather/station/{icao}/health`).

The default view (no `source`) is `changes` + `commons` only and makes no
relay call; weather-health rows appear only with `source=weather-health`.

API-verdict receipts (cross_lens, preflight, scry, self, …) are NOT public:
ADR-010 keeps them hashes-only, so they are not in this ledger. The
weather-health rows are not API-verdict receipts: they are TunnelMind's own
judgements over public NWS observations, already public on the relay.

Searchable, NOT downloadable: `limit` is at most 100, there is no NDJSON,
no `format=` and no day dump. Bulk goes through the tollbooth export.
Changes rows carry public fields only — no receipt body, no
`customer_id`. Commons rows carry the signed tollbooth document
verbatim (`receipt`, or `receipt_unreadable: true` when the stored
document does not parse). Weather-health rows carry the signed health
receipt verbatim (`receipt`) with its `day`, `station`, `verdict`,
`rules_version` and chain `sequence`.

Each source is read and degraded on its own: `sources.<name>.coverage` is
`observed_clean`, `never_observed` (an honest absence, e.g. `day=` the open
day, or no closed day published yet; with a `reason`) or `degraded` with a
`reason`. A degraded source contributes no
rows; the response is still 200, never a crash and never an empty list
passed off as clean. Only the sources the filters can match are listed.

Paging: `truncated` is true when more rows exist; pass `next_cursor` as
`cursor` for the next page. Rows are ordered by issued_at (newest first),
then source (`changes`, then `commons`, then `weather-health`), then id, and the cursor marks the
last row returned, so rows sharing a timestamp are never skipped or repeated.

400 `invalid_request` on a malformed `q`, `source`, `kind`, `day`,
`before`, `cursor` or `limit` (including `source=receipts`), on `cursor`
with `before`, and on `kind` with `source=commons` or `source=weather-health`.

`?receipt=true` attaches a signed Receipt v1.0 over the result. It is
not written to the receipts ledger (`receipt_logged: false`): the rows
are already signed at source, and logging each search would feed the
`changes` source.

Rate limits: anonymous: 10 per minute per IP; no daily cap on /v1/self, /v1/pricing, /v1/ledger and /v1/weather/station/{icao}/health; other anonymous probes 100 per day; free tier 50 per day. For anonymous callers this route has no daily cap and keeps 10/min; API-key tiers keep their daily cap.

before.description: Only rows strictly older than this ISO 8601 instant (timezone required). A time filter, not a paging cursor; cannot be combined with `cursor`.

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor: pass `next_cursor` from the previous page, unchanged, with the same other filters. 1-256 base64url characters encoding JSON `{t, s, i}` (the last row's issued_at, source and id); anything else, or `cursor` with `before`, is a 400.

day.description: Only rows issued on this UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD). Not in the future.

kind.description: Only changes of this kind. Applies to the `changes` source only.

q.description: Substring to match (changes — subject or summary; commons — path class; weather-health — station or flag id). 0-100 chars of letters, digits, space and `._:/#@-`.

receipt.description: When true, attach a signed Receipt v1.0 over the result (not logged to the receipts ledger). Additive — a signing failure never costs you the observation (ADR-014).

source.description: Only this source. Omit for the default view, `changes` + `commons` (weather-health only when asked for).

name: ledger_search
